groups.title: Outcome type
groups.subtitle: What does your dependent variable look like?

groups.title: Endogeneity risk
groups.subtitle: Could X be tangled with unobservables?

ols.title: OLS regression
ols.why: Baseline for continuous outcomes and clear interpretation.
ols.diagnostic: Check residual plots, leverage, and heteroskedasticity.

logit.title: Logit / Probit
logit.why: Models binary outcomes with probabilities constrained to 0-1.
logit.stata:
logit y x1 x2
margins, dydx(*)
logit.diagnostic: Report marginal effects and predicted probabilities.

count.title: Poisson / Negative binomial
count.why: Counts need non-negative predictions and overdispersion checks.
count.stata:
poisson y x1 x2, vce(robust)
estat gof
nbreg y x1 x2, vce(robust)

fractional.title: Fractional response
fractional.why: Handles proportions between 0 and 1 without impossible predictions.
fractional.stata:
fracreg logit y x1 x2
margins, dydx(*)
fractional.diagnostic: Inspect fitted values for boundary issues.
fractional.pitfall: Treating fractions as binary or using OLS.

hazard.title: Hazard / duration models
hazard.stata:
stset duration, failure(event)
stcox x1 x2, vce(robust)

panel.title: Panel FE/RE
panel.why: Controls for time-invariant unobserved factors in panel data.
panel.stata:
xtset id time
xtreg y x1 x2, fe vce(cluster id)
panel.diagnostic: Compare FE vs RE and test for serial correlation.
panel.pitfall: Forgetting to cluster at the panel level.

iv.title: Instrumental variables
iv.why: Corrects for endogeneity when a valid instrument exists.
iv.diagnostic: Check first-stage strength and exclusion logic.

did.title: Difference-in-differences
did.why: Causal design when a treatment shocks one group over time.
did.stata:
xtset id time
xtreg y i.treated##i.post, fe vce(cluster id)
did.pitfall: Ignoring staggered adoption or pre-trend violations.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics checklist
diagnostics.diagnostic: Report diagnostics in an appendix or robustness section.
diagnostics.pitfall: Skipping checks because the model looks significant.

reporting.title: Reporting standard
reporting.why: Translate estimates into plain-language results and tables.
reporting.diagnostic: State assumptions, identification, and robustness clearly.
reporting.pitfall: Only reporting p-values without effect size context.
